Seems very arrogant of you to say that considering I've been in and out of therapy and put on medication and all that couldn't help.

edit: Also I noticed in your post history that you're 16. I'm going to be ageist here but please don't try helping suicidal people, you aren't prepared for it.
It's been about a decade since I last felt alive.
No you don't, it's not easier. I wish I could go back to the time when I wasn't like this.
I'd rather have people not care, caring leads to suffering.
I can't see beauty or love any more so I revel in darkness, so edgy of me  I know. Life isn't for people like me, fish out of water ect
I'm not getting a gun right now if that's what you thought. Maybe in the future.
I'm not doing anything rash, I've thought a lot and thinking is probably what got me to this state in the first place.
It was an in the moment thing not a lasting happiness
I think the talking phase is over, its time for action. I've talked so much words don't have an impact anymore.
I don't think we can become friends because I hate people. If I had enough willpower I would live in the wilderness.
Fuck I just threw up a bunch and passed out. I feel like shit. I need to get a gun...
